This folder ships the reference WebP decoder/native library:

- libwebp.dll, libwebpdemux.dll, libsharpyuv.dll
  from the official libwebp project (https://chromium.googlesource.com/webm/libwebp),
  obtained as the prebuilt win-x64 binaries of the `Imazen.WebP.NativeRuntime.win-x64`
  NuGet package (1.6.1). Animated WebP is decoded through `libwebpdemux`'s
  WebPAnimDecoder API (ABI 0x0107).
